request: Analyze GSE101239 for PMID 29610328 (Ectopic neurogenesis induced by prenatal antiepileptic drug exposure augments seizure susceptibility in adult mice.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq (50-bp SE, HiSeq 2500) of FACS-sorted Nestin-EGFP+ NS/PCs; forebrain at E15, dentate gyrus at P5 and 12w
final.primary_estimand: Effect of 8 wk voluntary wheel running on the adult (12w) dentate-gyrus NS/PC transcriptome of prenatally VPA-exposed mice: VPA+RW vs VPA (S1.4.p2, Fig. 5). Exercise was only given to VPA mice; there is no Ctrl+RW arm, so the exercise effect is identifiable only within VPA-exposed animals.
planned_contrasts: VPA+RW vs VPA at 12w (S1.4.p2, Fig. 5B-E; exercise estimand; paper reports no DEG count, only that running mostly amended VPA-distorted genes incl. Cxcr4)
VPA vs Ctrl at 12w (S1.2.p1, Fig. 2B/3; defines the VPA-DEG set that running normalizes; 12w count not stated in text, hundreds per S2.p2)
VPA+RW vs Ctrl at 12w (implicit normalization check in Fig. 5B box plots)
final.inclusion: Exercise estimand uses the 9 12w DG samples (3 Ctrl, 3 VPA, 3 VPA+Run); E15 and P5 samples are VPA-only developmental comparisons without exercise and were analysed per stage in the paper (S1.2.p1).
final.paper_results: E15 VPA vs Ctrl: 248 DEGs (235 up). 12w VPA vs Ctrl: Cxcr4 and Cntn2 down (Fig. 3D-E). Running normalizes VPA-DEGs incl. Cxcr4 (Fig. 5).

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: Paper S1.4.p1-p2 and Fig. 5 define the exercise question: VPA mice with vs without 8 wk running at 12w. Threshold q<0.05 and FC>=1.5 at S1.2.p1; Cuffdiff in GEO data_processing. GSE101239 cited in the JATS data-availability statement.

checks: 21 samples: Ctrl/VPA at E15, P5, 12w plus VPA+Run 12w match Fig. 2A and Fig. 5A
treatment_protocol matches VPA 300 mg/kg E12-14; Nestin-EGFP genotype matches S1.2.p1

ownership.reasoning: Accession cited by the paper; sample structure and protocol match the paper.

exclude_samples.GSM2700529: E15 forebrain; no exercise arm at this stage; paper analyses each stage separately (S1.2.p1)
exclude_samples.GSM2700535: P5 DG; no exercise arm at this stage

alignment.reasoning: Tar per-sample files are named by GSM; exact match to the metadata index (21/21). Group derived from title (Control/VPA/VPA+Run at 12w). Per-sample file headers (Ctrl_12w_n_FPKM, VPA_12w_n_FPKM, VPA_12w_RUNn_FPKM) agree with the GSM titles.

final.source: GSE101239_RAW.tar per-sample Cufflinks gene FPKM (12w headers end in _FPKM)
final.paper_input: Cuffdiff on aligned reads; not deposited

matrix.reasoning: Per-sample file headers end in _FPKM (12w) and data_processing names Cufflinks/Cuffdiff; integer fraction 0.36 with decimals, per-sample totals ~4.8e5 (not counts). Counts are not deposited.

candidates.value: pool Ctrl and VPA as sedentary vs VPA+Run
candidates.reason_rejected: pools levels with different prenatal exposure; confounds exercise with VPA

candidates.value: include E15/P5 samples in one model with stage
candidates.reason_rejected: different tissue/stage, no exercise arm; paper analysed within stage
no Ctrl+RW arm; interaction not identifiable

design.reasoning: One-way three-level model on the 12w samples; primary exercise contrast VPA+Run vs VPA (Fig. 5). VPA vs Ctrl is the paper's 12w DEG set that running normalizes; VPA+Run vs Ctrl is the normalization check (exploratory).

covariance.reasoning: Independent animals per group; no batch, sex or pairing recorded in GEO or paper.

paper_route.reason: Cuffdiff needs read-level input; GEO deposits only per-sample FPKM

deviations: BH-adjusted limma p instead of Cuffdiff q
three 12w groups fitted in one model (shared variance) instead of pairwise Cuffdiff

method.reasoning: Matrix policy: FPKM -> log2(x+1) -> limma. Never round FPKM for a count model.

final.deviation_note: q<0.05 and FC>=1.5 (S1.2.p1) converted exactly to padj<0.05 and |log2FC|>=log2(1.5)=0.5849625, applied on the limma route. Paper defined DEGs for VPA vs Ctrl; it never counted VPA+RW vs VPA DEGs.

caveats: Exercise effect is identifiable only in VPA-exposed mice (no Ctrl+RW arm).
n = 3 per group; limma on FPKM replaces Cuffdiff.
Paper gives no DEG count for VPA+RW vs VPA or for 12w VPA vs Ctrl in the text.

study.reasoning: Paper: Cxcr4 and Cntn2 down in VPA vs Ctrl at 12w (Fig. 3D-E); running restores Cxcr4 (Fig. 5E), so expected up in VPA+RW vs VPA.

discrepancies.data: tar file names say Contol (typo); stage excluded anyway

executions.name: limma_12w
executions.reasoning: One limma model on log2(FPKM+1) of the 9 12w samples; primary exercise contrast VPA+Run vs VPA, VPA vs Ctrl secondary, VPA+Run vs Ctrl exploratory.

enrichment.reasoning: Paper interprets running via cell-migration GO terms (Fig. 5C-D); GSEA uses the full ranking.
